title: PBA: Ginebra humbles King, San Miguel to book semis clash vs. TNT
summary: Barangay Ginebra San Miguel humbled George King and San Miguel Beer, 110-94, in Game 5 to book its semifinals ticket in the PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup on Tuesday at Ynares Center-Antipolo.
